tools.name: find_direct_places
tools.description: Places in a city that take a booking or an order on their own website, best Agent-Direct Scores first, with the direct booking or ordering link for each (the owner's corrected link where the business is claimed), the vendor behind it, verified_at when a browser reached the step before confirming, the vendor's terms for agents when noted, the hours, and follow links (https://directindex.org/go/{domain}/book, /order, /menu) that count. Use it to recommend places a person can book or order from directly, without a marketplace. Optional query: a cuisine, a dish or a few words, for example pizza, sushi, vegan, francesinha. Optional filters: lat, lon and radius_m for places near a point; open_now for places open at this moment in the city's zone (unknown hours stay in, marked null); verified_only for links a browser verified; vendor for one booking or ordering vendor (slug as on https://directindex.org/vendors). The same lists exist as pages at https://directindex.org/city/{slug}/direct, /direct/book, /direct/order and /direct/{want}; the full record of one place is available by domain.

city.description: City slug, for example lisbon; see list_cities

query.description: What the person wants: a cuisine, a dish or a few words. Empty for any.

want.description: book: a table; order: food to collect or deliver; any: either

lat.description: Latitude of the person; with lon, only places within radius_m

open_now.description: Only places open right now by their OpenStreetMap hours, in the city's zone; places with unreadable hours stay in with open_now null

verified_only.description: Only links a browser verified: an agent reached the step before confirming

vendor.description: Only places on this booking or ordering vendor, by slug: zenchef, sevenrooms, toast ...
